metadata.description: Opt-in alpha: Desk and Crew retain durable work state and authority; pinned Superpowers is the engineering method, independent review has one remediation owner, and Plain Language and Ponytail govern prose and coding size. Host packaging does not imply runtime qualification.

plugins.name: desk
plugins.description: A quiet workspace substrate for long-running engineering agents: tracks, tasks, friction notes, lessons, lifecycle skills, and an MCP server for desk CRUD plus search. Ships a default 'worker' agent that makes the plugin standalone-functional; overlays (corporate, autonomous, personal-coding) layer their own agents on top.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Pinned Superpowers 6.3.0, selected for the opt-in Desk alpha through its state and authority integration.

plugins.name: work-suite
plugins.description: Legacy standalone Work Suite technical preview. Retained for existing installations; not selected alongside Superpowers by the Desk alpha.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: The multi-person shared-workspace layer on top of desk: crew onboarding through an overlay-supplied identity, read-across/write-own desks/<alias>/ subtrees, the facts-vs-perspectives-vs-decisions attribution taxonomy, the conflict-safe write protocol, and perspective queries. Vendor-neutral.

plugins.name: plain-language
plugins.description: A first-party output policy that makes human-readable agent prose easy to find, understand, and use without weakening evidence, uncertainty, safety, precision, schemas, quotations, or requested voice.

plugins.name: ponytail-upstream
plugins.description: Unmodified Ponytail v4.9.0 skills and hooks by Dietrich Gebert, packaged for Ourostack.
